description: This PHP source file defines the I18NImportErrorAPI class, which serves as an API endpoint for listing internationalization import error records within an HRM system. It includes annotations for API documentation, uses traits for authentication and localization services, and defines methods for retrieving paginated, sortable error data filtered by language ID.
